dialect.detail: IBM mainframe batch COBOL; uses RECORDING MODE IS F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, ASSIGN TO UT-S-ddname conventions, VSAM INDEXED file (PATMSTR), COMP/COMP-3, GOBACK, RETURN-CODE special register

purpose.domain_detail: Inpatient hospital treatment record processing; searches sorted treatment records against a lab test table, calculates lab costs via a called subprogram, and writes matched records to an output file
purpose.summary: TRMTSRCH reads sorted inpatient treatment records and a lab test reference file, loads the lab test data into an in-memory table, searches each treatment record's lab charges against the table, calls an external cost-calculation subprogram (CLCLBCST), and writes matched records plus a trailer to an output file. It also validates record counts against a trailer record and abends on errors.

notable_features: VSAM INDEXED file access (PATMSTR) with RECORD KEY and FILE STATUS
SEARCH statement with INDEXED BY for lab test table lookup
CALL to external subprogram CLCLBCST with CALC-COSTS-REC
Trailer record validation with record count balancing
88-level condition names for file status and lab test categories
GOBACK with MOVE ZERO TO RETURN-CODE
Inline comment noting a known bug (NICE BUG comment)
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars but the visible portion covers nearly all logic. The program references copybooks TREATMNT, PATMSTR, and ABENDREC which are not shown. A developer comment explicitly flags a known bug ('NICE BUG = THIS SHOULD BE IN 100-MAINLINE'). Author is Jon Sayles, associated with COBOL Development Center training materials, so this may be a teaching/courseware example despite production-like structure.
